rights.license_name: MIT for model weights/code; tokenizer component rights unresolved
field_or_scale_restrictions: The model card identifies the tokenizer as the LLaMA 3 tokenizer; independent derivative-redistribution rights for that third-party-origin tokenizer component were not established from the public metadata reviewed by B006.
rights.rationale: Microsoft declares MIT for the model weights and code, but MSTR FR-016 requires every required tokenizer/component to satisfy the same rights gate. The card explicitly identifies a LLaMA 3 tokenizer while the reviewed metadata does not establish its independent redistribution provenance. BitNet therefore remains a technical control but is not primary-rights eligible. No terms were accepted and no tokenizer artifact was downloaded.

architecture.tokenizer_id: LLaMA 3 tokenizer as identified by Microsoft BitNet model card

runtime_support_notes: Native 1.58-bit architecture is a useful efficiency control, but the BF16 repository card documents SFT and DPO after pretraining and a native context length of 4096, below the MSTR 8K reference.
Standard Transformers does not provide the optimized execution path; B009 owns custom-runtime compatibility.
quantization_support_notes: Native 1.58-bit packed sibling and bitnet.cpp are public references; B006 downloaded neither model nor tokenizer artifacts.
